svg.title: svrngs: same acts, same state
svg.desc: Each device signs its own acts, linked like git. Admission puts them in one order and refuses by name; every copy folds them to the same state. The code nests from a pure core out to the command. We run the phones’ page, a relay and the builds, and each can be your own. You extend it with an app: one on a port, a folder the group keeps, or a game.
svg.text: Small enough to read in an afternoon. Batteries included, every one replaceable.
